The NO's own peak-PK1-stress error, scored the SAME way torch-fem's is (compute_peak_stress_error, fixed location x_star/peak_ref located once from a fine N=1401 ground truth). Checkpoint verified by fingerprint (zeroshot_B1_neo_hookean/model_best.pt). Headline: the NO's peak-stress error is bad EVERYWHERE (60.7%-73.6%), not a resolution-dependent effect the way L2/H1/energy are -- best at N=101 (60.7%), worst at N=1401 (73.6%), non-monotonic in between. x_star is essentially the (0,0) domain corner -- a plausible boundary-condition-transition point (a classic slow-convergence/near-singularity location in FEM); this may mean 'peak stress at this exact point' is not a well-posed target for either method to converge to, a caveat that should temper how much weight this one metric is given in the 'coarsest suitable FEM' conclusion.
